not_in_files._: Settings changes these through a tool or D-Bus, not a config key; they are not synced, and why
not_in_files.power profile (power-profiles-daemon): the profiles a PC offers depend on its hardware
not_in_files.time zone and automatic time (timedated): set for the whole PC, and follows where it is
not_in_files.Wi-Fi, VPN, Bluetooth pairings, hotspot: networks, devices and their secrets stay on the PC
not_in_files.sound devices and volumes: the devices differ from PC to PC
not_in_files.look and feel (plasma-apply-lookandfeel): it rewrites the panel layout; theme, colors, accent and wallpaper sync on their own
not_in_files.per-app notification rules, startup apps: keyed by app or hardware, see excluded
not_in_files.game mode: Settings only shows it; Raye Gaming switches it on per game
